prompt.project_info: Photorealistic 4K-style high-angle candid selfie of a clearly adult woman reclining in a bright attic or loft bedroom with soft skylight daylight and a social-media aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with fair skin and detailed natural skin texture, long dark-brown straight-to-slightly-wavy hair falling behind her shoulders, green-hazel eyes looking directly at the camera, soft relaxed confident expression, minimal makeup and small gold diamond hoop earrings. Do not reproduce Ana de Armas or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Use a high-angle selfie perspective with the arm extended. The adult woman reclines on her belly on a bed with her feet raised, bare lower legs visible in the background, and the close-up centered on her upper body while capturing the legs behind. She wears a bright white soccer jersey with navy-blue accents, deep V neckline, thin vertical navy pinstripes, loose casual fit, navy sleeve trim, black Adidas logo on the right chest, navy shoulder stripes, shield-shaped yellow-green team crest on the left chest, and the source-described abstract black sponsor graphic on the center. Include pink or mauve plush bedding and pillows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daylight enters through a rectangular skylight in the slanted wood ceiling, creating soft diffused high-key light and gentle shadows across the face, bedding and jersey folds. Keep the atmosphere sunny, relaxed and casual.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K-style HD candid selfie, high-angle smartphone perspective, realistic skin texture and jersey creases, natural smartphone optics, crisp subject detail, no added text, logos or watermark beyond the source-described jersey elements.
